snippet.title: Wibble World Giddy
snippet.description:
A PD game on the Amiga by Phil Ruston.

http://www.retroleum.co.uk/giddy3/misc.html

It's a fun parody of the Dizzy games. I also only found out today it has a couple of sequels, one on the Amiga and one on the PC.
